cards.text: Combining environmental information, asset context and engineering rules to support faster identification of potentially high-risk flood conditions.

cards.label: Industrial waste-heat recovery
cards.title: Industrial waste-heat recovery

cards.label: Engineering design limits

cards.text: Using structural, thermal and fluid simulation to understand critical loads, deformation, performance margins and sensitivity to real-world variability.

cards.label: AI-supported engineering workflows
cards.title: AI-supported engineering workflows
cards.text: Transforming technical survey data, engineering rules and repeatable design steps into transparent digital workflows for faster engineering delivery.

cards.label: From failure mechanism to better geometry
cards.title: From failure mechanism to better geometry
cards.text: Investigating why components fail in service and translating the diagnosis into design changes, improved material behaviour or better test evidence.

cards.label: Carbon capture feasibility
cards.title: Carbon capture feasibility
cards.text: Screening carbon-capture concepts at system level, including process integration, energy demand and practical implementation constraints.
